name: Tapo L510E (EU)

matter.note: TP-Link's EU pages and datasheet list only Alexa and Google, and we found no CSA listing for the L510E. Not confirmed.

apple_home.note: TP-Link's EU pages list only Alexa and Google, but no official source says Apple Home is unsupported. Not confirmed.

google_home.note: Through the Tapo integration in Google Home, linked from the Tapo app.

smartthings.note: A 2024 TP-Link guide covering L510/L520/L530 bulbs mentions SmartThings, but TP-Link's SmartThings FAQ names the L520E and L530E, not the L510E, and the EU product page omits it.

home_assistant.note: Listed as supported by the official TP-Link Smart Home integration; needs your TP-Link account credentials.

hubRequired.note: Here this means needing a bridge or hub for basic app control. It joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi directly and is controlled from the Tapo app; no hub needed.

localControl.note: Home Assistant's TP-Link integration controls supported devices on the local network, though it authenticates with your TP-Link account credentials.

colorType.note: Fixed warm white, 2700 K; dimmable from 1 to 100% in the app.

lumens.note: 806 lm, comparable to a 60 W incandescent.

bulbBase.note: A60 shape with E27 base for the EU version.

summary: The Tapo L510E (EU) is a dimmable, fixed warm white (2700 K) E27 bulb rated at 806 lumens. It joins 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi directly, with no hub, and works with Alexa and Google Home through TP-Link's skill and integration. Home Assistant's official TP-Link Smart Home integration lists it. Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter are unconfirmed.
caveats: Dimming works from the app and voice only; TP-Link says not to use it with traditional wall dimmers.
Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter support aren't confirmed for this model.
Home Assistant needs your TP-Link account credentials.
